name: Vernaccia di San Gimignano

known.via: English Wikipedia "Vernaccia di San Gimignano" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A white wine made from the Vernaccia grape in and around San Gimignano, a Tuscan hill town. It was the first Italian wine to receive DOC status, in 1966, and became a DOCG in 1993.
